_about: Ambush encounters (List 22 #209). Two pieces: (1) a table-level eligibility slot PROPOSED into #7's spawn-table spec + schema, per the #158 horde-slot precedent — absent/null everywhere today; (2) the initiation kind on the ordinary encounter record. The battle after initiation is an ordinary wild battle (#18/#17/#38); ambush grants no mechanical edge of any kind.

encounterMode == safari (#170): a battle-free zone cannot host a battle initiation
the Dark Forest depths: the table carries 0 slots (verified in dark-forest.spawn-tables.json) — nothing can charge from an empty table; the exclusion is arithmetic, not a list
